applicant.organisation: ÖH Student Union Salzburg, student welfare fund

purpose: Our supplementary health cover for students is running out of money. We want to know the size of the diabetic group so we can exclude pre-existing conditions from new policies.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
